method: The auditor read docs/editorial-policy.md, scope.md and drafting-brief.md, then the 51 claims with their evidence, sources and object entities from pack.json, without reading the drafts' 'searched' notes or any coordinator commentary. Every cited source was retrieved again, sequentially, into the auditor's own cache (LG_CACHE=audit, keys audit-<source id>), and each passage was located with tools.mjs text/grep. Chinese PDF text layers were NFKC-normalised for matching. Versions and dates were checked independently of the pack's notes: blobless git clones of MoonshotAI/Kimi-K2 and Kimi-k1.5, MiniMax-AI/MiniMax-01 and MiniMax-M2, and ByteDance-Seed/seed-oss, plus the Hugging Face commits and tree APIs for Kimi-K2-Thinking, Kimi-K3, MiniMax-M3, Seed-OSS-36B-Instruct, Seed-Coder-8B-Instruct and ERNIE-4.5-300B-A47B-PT. The image-only AIIA commitment text and signatory list (the CAICT WeChat post's 1000x9898 px image) was downloaded and viewed in slices by the auditor. The cover, Commitment II and the 17-name list were read; the other commitments were not checked visually. Machine translations were compared with the Chinese originals. Same-family check: it does not satisfy the policy's cross-family requirement.
